column7: The Test splits into two channels below Barton Stacey, both named River Test by OS; they meet again below Chilbolton. The eastern channel starts at node 6AB9D06B, 21 m from the western channel's link 88C6258E, and OS joins it to nothing but a 74 m ditch, so it carried the River Dever and 0.1 km of network instead of the Test. The Chilbolton Cow Common spot (osm-test-chilbolton) is on that channel and showed no overflow within 60 km (site review, 11 Oct 2026), with Overton SSO and SWS90060 upstream on the Test. Joined from the start of 88C6258E, 512 m above the point beside the channel's start, plus the 21 m gap. Inferred from OS geometry and names; not checked against another map.
